skill.name: douyin-product-comparison
skill.description: Compare two to five selected Douyin products using SocialDataX details or supplied information, with price conditions, specifications, sources, and missing fields.
skill.summary: Create traceable Douyin product comparisons without inventing prices, sales figures, or unsupported rankings.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: All 26 static matches concern Markdown syntax, documented service configuration, product parameters, or readable Chinese text, rather than the reported threats. A separate supply-chain risk exists because CLI examples automatically execute the latest npm package with access to the configured API credential. No evidence found of prompt injection, embedded secrets, or intentional credential exfiltration in the reviewed skill files; external package behavior was not verified.

remediation.issue: CLI examples execute an unpinned npm package through npx with automatic confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed version, document package verification, and obtain permission before installation. Limit credentials and environment access during execution.

content.user_title: Compare Douyin Products with Traceable Sources
content.value_statement: Different specifications and promotional prices make Douyin products difficult to compare. This skill organizes selected products into source-linked comparisons with clear price conditions and information gaps.
actual_capabilities: Compare two to five user-selected products from Douyin links, product IDs, or supplied product information.
Guide product-detail retrieval through the SocialDataX CLI or corresponding MCP tools.
Separate SKU differences, package quantities, coupon prices, promotional prices, and price ranges.
Calculate unit prices only when quantities and units are known.
Produce Markdown comparisons with source links or IDs, observation times, visible selling points, and missing information.
Identify use-case differences and follow-up checks without unsupported rankings or invented metrics.
limitations: Live retrieval requires SocialDataX access, a configured API key, available balance, and a working CLI or MCP connection.
The skill does not discover competitors or expand selected products into category searches.
Unavailable fields remain missing; customer reviews, actual sales, market share, and profit are not inferred from unrelated information.
The npm CLI implementation is external to these files, and its runtime behavior was not verified during this audit.

use_cases.title: Check Comparable Purchase Options
use_cases.description: Compare selected listings by package size, price conditions, and missing specifications before making a purchase.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Competitor Comparison
use_cases.description: Organize selected competing products into a source-linked table that separates visible selling points from independently supported evidence.

use_cases.title: Build a Procurement Shortlist
use_cases.description: Compare known product candidates, normalize supported unit prices, and list questions that require supplier confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Products
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these Douyin products: [link A] and [link B]. Show specifications, price conditions, sources, and missing information.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner comparison of two selected listings

prompt_templates.title: Compare Package Value
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [two to five product IDs] by package quantity and unit price. Separate promotional conditions and calculate only when units and quantities are explicit.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate comparison of differently sized packages

prompt_templates.title: Review Competing Selling Points
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [selected product links] for [target use case]. Separate promotional claims from supporting information, retain sources, and list checks needed before ranking.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Evidence-Based Decision Table
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [two to five selected products] using [priority dimensions]. Normalize compatible units, separate SKUs and discounts, record observation times, and explain uncertainties without unsupported winners.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced comparison with explicit decision criteria

output_examples.input: Using supplied sample data, compare product A at CNY 60 for 500 g and product B at CNY 100 for 1 kg.
output: Illustrative comparison based only on the supplied sample data.
Product A: CNY 12 per 100 g. Product B: CNY 10 per 100 g.
Product B has the lower listed unit price. Coupon conditions, shipping, and specification equivalence remain unverified.
Source: user-provided sample. Product links, IDs, and observation times were not supplied.

output_examples.input: Compare two supplied listings: product A has a coupon price; product B has no package quantity.
output: Product A: label the coupon price separately. Confirm coupon eligibility and purchase conditions.
Product B: package quantity not provided. Unit price cannot be calculated.
No overall ranking: the available information does not establish comparable purchase conditions.
Sources: supplied listings. Retain their links or IDs and record the observation time when available.

best_practices: Provide two to five exact product links or IDs and state the comparison dimensions that matter.
Confirm SKU, package size, unit, and discount conditions before comparing prices.
Use a reviewed CLI version, protect API credentials, and preserve sources and observation times.
anti_patterns: Treating different SKUs, package sizes, or conditional discounts as equivalent prices.
Inventing missing specifications, sales figures, customer reviews, or profit estimates.
Expanding into competitor discovery or executing dependency changes without user authorization.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide two to five Douyin product links, product IDs, or product records, plus the differences you want examined.

faq.question: Do I need a SocialDataX API key?
faq.answer: Live retrieval requires SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and sufficient service balance. Comparisons can also use product information you supply.

faq.question: Can it find competitors automatically?
faq.answer: No. The workflow compares products you select and does not perform category searches or choose competitors.

faq.question: Can it identify the cheapest product?
faq.answer: Only when specifications, quantities, units, and price conditions support comparison. Missing evidence prevents a reliable ranking.

faq.question: Does it access my Douyin account?
faq.answer: The instructions specify read-only retrieval without browser data access, login, posting, likes, comments, or account changes. External CLI behavior was not independently verified.

faq.question: What happens when a data request fails?
faq.answer: Ordinary network or API errors receive one retry after configuration checks. Insufficient balance pauses retries until the service balance issue is resolved.
